name: Takahama (Aichi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takahama city emblem in navy: an outlined ring open at the top enclosing stylised arches.
history: Municipal flag of Takahama, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 June 1954.

features.role: Takahama city emblem — an outlined ring open at the top enclosing stylised arches
